descriptions.en: Client-only suffix-grouped composer model picker with standalone Plan Review and no provider runtime dependency.
descriptions.zh: 纯客户端后缀分组 Composer 模型选择器，带独立 Plan Review，不依赖具体 Provider 运行时。

notice.en: This plugin has been absorbed by dsh-model-switch. Do not install both because they compete for the same picker seat.
notice.zh: 该插件已并入 dsh-model-switch。请勿同时安装，两者会竞争同一个选择器位置。
